## Summary

What changes and why. Link the issue, if there is one.

## Evidence

How you know it works: the tests you added or ran, output before and after.

## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`uv run pre-commit install` sets up the check)
- [ ] `uv run pre-commit run --all-files` and `uv run pytest` pass
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under Unreleased if users will notice the change
- [ ] If an AI coding agent drafted this, the description says so, and I can explain every line
